note: The sketch this app's creator was shown when they made it (design/sketch.html). The first version keeps its layout, its words and its accent; any deviation is listed under Assumptions with the reason.
job: Save and plan hikes around Geneva with transit directions
layout: Header with title and your name
List of saved hikes, each showing the hike name, distance, transit method and time
Primary action to save a new hike at the bottom
signature: Transit time and method shown for each hike, since getting there is half the adventure
